name: GPU
fix_description: In _transfer, add require(from != to) to prevent self-transfers. The self-transfer exploit allows manipulation of the fee/burn mechanism - when from==to the balance is unchanged but fees are still deducted to _destroyAddress and address(this), creating accounting discrepancy that can be exploited via swapAndLiquify.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very straightforward flash-loan-funded tokenomics exploit: borrow BUSD, buy the vulnerable token, abuse a self-transfer balance-doubling bug in a simple loop, then sell and repay. It involves only a few steps, minimal protocol-specific reasoning, and the PoC is short and obvious once the faulty transfer logic is identified.
